label: latency budget study on CPU: measured local stage latencies for the Build voice pipeline (frame and VAD split, streaming partial intent tracing, Learn rule intent and answer reused by import, tone WAV synthesis, barge-in over audio frames; no ASR model, no TTS model, no LLM), modelled cloud pipeline from stated constants (modelled only, never measured), Muse VM, standard library only
method: Each local stage call is timed individually with time.perf_counter_ns after warmup, in 3 repeated batches whose per-call samples are pooled; per stage and case the file reports n, mean, median, p90, p99, min, max in microseconds (nearest-rank percentiles). Sample counts: intent and answer 300, streaming 300, frame and VAD 100, WAV synthesis 30, barge-in drop 60, barge-in full 20; barge-in setups run untimed per call. Latency fields are measured and vary between runs, so this file is NOT byte-identical across runs; deterministic fields (correctness, counts, sizes, modelled totals) are identical across runs. Cloud figures are modelled from stated constants only: network 80 ms, ASR final 300 ms, LLM answer 700 ms, TTS 100 ms plus 5 ms per response word.
